method: Read actual baseline guard/effect/retry and frozen owning source control paths; verify exact owner byte/mode identity separately; inspect scoped dependency boundaries. No test execution.
limits: Finite source guard/effect/retry conformance at the frozen source commit only. No runtime, host/package qualification, model compliance, task/scenario, provider/authentication, physical consent, endpoint policy, publication or whole-program readiness claim. HOLD rows receive no ledger mutation.

rows.conformance: Leading BOM stripped once and CRLF globally normalized; other text remains. parseDoc deliberately does not normalize on its own.
Exact first/closing delimiter extracts flat block and trims only leading empty body lines; missing/unclosed block returns null with original body.
First colon, trimmed fields and one matching quote pair; blank/colonless ignored and repeated assignment overwrites. No nested-YAML rejection guarantee.
Admitted0–3-space backtick/tilde opener stores exact character/length and marks opening line fenced; contents have no procedural interpretation.
Closing must match character, minimum length and whitespace suffix; failed closer remains fenced, absent closer carries through EOF.
ATX reader ignores fenced lines and returns level/text/index with trailing hashes removed; optional demotion affects only levels1–5.
Loader validates schema/taxonomy order/metadata and exact route set plus bidirectional alias closure; malformed/missing/unknown/duplicate/alias-target errors throw.
Frontmatter/fenced headings skipped; first H1 claims only a bare lowercase identifier. /ca: text or no admitted heading yields no claimed owner.
Every claim must name one shipped skill with one command owner; problems aggregate. Alias visibility retains page, other visibility merges. Catalog required only after nonempty claims.
Pure derived pair-role map sets merged/alias-owner or default internal-only; it neither enables nor disables a runtime skill.
Merged redirects are base-aware; historical supplied -2 set resolves directly to final command/skill. Alias owner remains live and later skills are not automatically historical.
Fixed type order, sorted sidebar titles and declared visibility/workflow groups produce pure return values; commands missing catalog or assignment throw.

Definition-specific caller counts Set(extracted tags), core/alias catalog entries, md agents excludingINDEX and skill directories. Changed extractor masking is explicit dependency boundary: no unchanged gate number, old extraction behavior or runtime message equivalence claimed.
Only absent optional directory yields empty map; present .md files are actually read/parsed and malformed input propagates rather than being treated absent.

BOM/CRLF normalized; frontmatter/nonempty entity required, minimal related syntax and gate accumulation until next item/dedent. Recognized incomplete gate throws; unsupported unrelated nesting is not broadly rejected.
Declared entity keys map; second same entity immediately throws while all orphan filenames accumulate. No independent location-equals-entity guarantee is invented.
Column0 nonempty required reader fields use shared shape spec; block scalars reject, workflow Example outside fences must have content, retired heading is rejected. Missing/empty errors aggregate.
Recognized /ca command is checked against catalog; nearest same-line command owns subsequent flags. Unknown commands are errors; missing command source skips additional flag attribution.

Without same-line command, carried code-block command or own command under Usage supplies owner. Whole-token flag presence checked in supplied command+skill text; known intervening foreign program or no owner skips attribution.
Outside fence or on delimiter the carried command resets; this scanner checks source-text mention, not flag implementation or execution.
No misses returns; any detected command/flag misses throw one aggregate with each file/line/token, rather than silently publishing drift.
Kind renderers assemble supplied description/reader/curated/merged/gate/related/compatibility/source layers and omit absent optional sections. They return text, never execute workflows.
Plain/code text HTML-escapes, emphasis is applied after escape; relative or http/https/mailto targets require no whitespace/control/DEL. Unsafe hyperlink token is escaped text.
Longest backtick run+1 with floor4 contains unmodified source in collapsed search-excluded details; real source-ref helper selects valid SHA or main. No execution or parent-disk-write claim.
Normalize/remove leading H1 and translate public Claude placeholder wording while linking the generic reviewer; returned documentation does not prove host dispatch.
First version heading strips preamble or falls back to trimmed whole text; pull links absolutized and sibling histories appended. No release metadata validation or rewritten timeline claimed.

Pure formatting preserves defined known-tier labels/default/unknown value, comma tools, sentence abbreviation handling, backslash-before-quote YAML escaping and public placeholders. No persistent workflow state effect.
